```plato
    // One point per grid cell, X fastest then Y then Z.
    // Precondition: every cell count is positive.
    JitteredGridPoints3D(region: Bounds3D, cellCounts: IntegerVector3, jitter: Number,
        seed: Integer): Array<Point3D>
        => (cellCounts.X * cellCounts.Y * cellCounts.Z).MapRange(n =>
            JitteredCellPoint3D(region, cellCounts, jitter, seed,
                n % cellCounts.X, n / cellCounts.X % cellCounts.Y, n / (cellCounts.X * cellCounts.Y)));
```
